Name: CP - SH's Trash Cats - Cat Replacers
Author: Plurffle
TagLine: Edits the sprites of the player's pet cats in-game with sprites of a fox, opossum, raccoon, rat, and skunk through the use of Content Patcher
Description:
![](https://imgur.com/i0qbWzk.png)
Someone requested I convert some of my animals from my [Wild Animals mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9063)  into pets.  ᓚᘏᗢ⋆˙⟡
This mod features sprites from my Wild Animals mod as pets, sprites for the UI section, and a config file that allows you to pick which animal replaces which cat of your choice (including an option to simply disable the change)! :D

![](https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png)
**Q: How to install this mod?**
**A:** Unzip the zip file and place the "[CP] SH's Trash Cats - Cat Replacers" folder in your Mods folder.

**Q: Is this mod compatible with mobile/multiplayer?**
**A:** I do not have the mobile version of the game, but I assume it should be work just fine in there since this is a Content Patcher mod. This should definitely work in multiplayer!

**Q: Is there going to be an [Alternative Textures](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246) version of this mod?**
**A:** You can get that here: [AT - SH's Trash Cats - Cat Replacers](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16797/)

**Q: Is there a version of this mod that doesn't replace the existing pet textures?**
**A:** Yes, actually! >w< It's called "[SH's More Adoptable Animals (More Custom Pets)](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23885)" and you can find that mod in my profile. Big thing to note is that adding new pets to the game was a feature added in the game's 1.6 update, therefore that mod will not work for any versions prior. The CP and AT version will work fine with 1.5 game version.

I just created a Ko-fi! If you like my works, then feel free to [buy me a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle) ~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
